script_text: Stop, Taurus—the cosmos is forcing a money reckoning before midnight. Saturn at one degree Aries is squaring Uranus in Gemini across your 12th and 2nd Houses, a tense 90-degree aspect that exposes hidden bills and sudden costs. Your ruler Venus, earth's sensual anchor, stations direct in Scorpio in your 8th House, so intimacy and shared funds become the real test. In love, Venus direct in the 8th brings a chance to repair trust with a partner; single Taurus, attract someone who honors your need for privacy and depth. In your 2nd House, Saturn square Uranus says no impulsive purchases; instead, audit subscriptions and ask for the raise you documented last month. Avoid lending money today; the blessing is a sudden refund or gift through your 8th House. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss Venus's next powerful move.
